label: Play Queue
tagline: Let viewers line up to play with you, first come first served.
description: Viewers type !join to get in line and !list to see who is next (the first 10). You (and your mods) run the line from chat: !queue open and !queue close accept or stop new joins, !queue next pulls up the next player, !queue remove <user> takes someone out, and !queue clear empties it. Viewers can step out any time with !leave. Turn the module on to enable the commands; the line survives closing so you can play through everyone already waiting.

join.label: Join confirmation
join.tagline: When a viewer joins the line.
join.defaultMessage: @{user} you joined the queue at position #{pos}.

already.label: Already in queue
already.tagline: When a viewer who is already in line types !join again.
already.defaultMessage: @{user} you are already in the queue at position #{pos}.

leave.label: Leave confirmation
leave.tagline: When a viewer steps out of the line.

next.label: Next player up
next.tagline: When you pull up the next player.
next.defaultMessage: @{target} you are up next! ({count} still waiting)

opened.label: Queue opened
opened.tagline: Announced when you open the queue.
opened.defaultMessage: The queue is now open! Type !join to get in line.

closed.label: Queue closed
closed.tagline: Announced when you close the queue.
closed.defaultMessage: The queue is now closed to new joins.

commands.join: Get in line to play (also !queue join).
commands.leave: Step out of the line (also !queue leave).
commands.list: Show the next 10 players waiting (also !queue list).
commands.queue: Show whether the queue is open and how many are waiting.
commands.queue_close: Stop accepting joins; the line is kept.
commands.queue_next: Pull up the next player and announce them.
commands.queue_remove_user: Take someone out of the line.
